model.name: R19.5: BY-INVITE rooms show an 'Apply' button instead of a join button; clicking it posts an invite-request message into the room with the requester's name and uuid, and an owner accepting that message joins the requester.
model.description: Tron literal: "by invite rooms send a invite request as a message into the room with the requesters name and uuid. the show not a join button like public rooms but an „Apply" button. the message can be accepted and they join."
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "by invite rooms send a invite request as a message into the room with the requesters name and uuid. the show not a join button like public rooms but an „Apply" button. the message can be accepted and they join."
